title: Coral and the Gravity
author: Ada Ashgrove
blurb: Oscar Dravenmoor, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
